content:
[L] high | bottom half of window | entire region below "Create Organization" is solid black dead space occupying ~55% of the viewport, content not filling the window
[S] high | form panel | "Name" and "Domains" labels sit at far left while their input fields are pushed to the far right edge, an absurd ~1000px gap that breaks label/value pairing
[S] high | form panel | inputs are right-aligned against the panel edge with no consistent margin, while the Create button is left-aligned — mixed alignment scheme within one form
[S] med | form panel | the Create Organization button is separated from the fields it acts on by a large gap and is not visually grouped with the form
[C] high | full layout | all content is crushed into the top ~45% of the window while the rest is empty, a severely unbalanced composition
[H] med | form panel | "Name"/"Domains" labels and placeholder text are the same small gray weight as metadata, giving the form no clear label hierarchy
[S] med | table action buttons | Open/Edit/Delete buttons nearly touch each other with inconsistent tiny gaps versus the roomier spacing elsewhere
[H] med | table rows | Delete rendered as a saturated red block button in every row draws the eye three times and overwhelms primary row content — destructive action over-emphasized
[S] low | filter row | Filter button floats at the far right with a large empty gap from the filter input, reading as two ungrouped controls
[H] low | header | "Organizations" title, subtitle, count, and Sync now all sit at similar small scale with weak contrast between title and subtitle
[S] low | table | column header text (ORGANIZATION, DOMAINS...) uses small all-caps gray type while row data mixes proportional and monospace fonts inconsistently
[C] low | table vs form | table is a bordered card but the form section below is a plain unbordered area with a stray horizontal rule, inconsistent section treatment

VERDICT: unprofessional — a half-empty form with detached labels, massive dead black space, and no coherent alignment system reads as a debug tool, not a product.

Only the table's numeric columns and row rhythm are roughly consistent; no other region is defect-free.
